purpose: Document first-party local/state cadastral evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-service review.
assessment: Tepic and Nayarit official sources establish municipal and state cadastral custodians and a paid digital-cartography procedure. The current public pages and indexed official report reviewed do not expose a qualifying anonymous parcel map/API response. The IMPLAN interactive page exposes traffic maps only. This is not evidence of citywide absence.
registryAssessment: Local/state registry custodians evidenced: Tepic's Dirección de Catastro e Impuesto Predial and Nayarit's Dirección General de Catastro y Registro Público / Dirección de Trámites y Servicios Catastrales. Public parcel-service integration is not evidenced.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Spanish service page describes digital cadastral cartography by predio, manzana, or localidad, delivered after application/payment through the Tepic cadastral office. No public machine-readable endpoint, schema, or CRS.
Official Tepic report states that a Visor de Planería de Catastro centralizes municipal urban-block plans as PDF. It does not provide an anonymous ID-plus-geometry service.
Official municipal organization page identifies the Dirección de Catastro e Impuesto Predial.
Official transparency page lists current cadastral-value and cadastral-service documents, with no parcel layer/API.
Current HTML/JavaScript inspected; iframes are traffic accident history and Waze traffic maps, not cadastral parcels.
